title: elaeagnus glabra var. oxyphylla
intro: Elaeagnus glabra var. oxyphylla, commonly known as Silverberry, is a plant species within the Elaeagnaceae family, characterized by its silver-green foliage and small, fragrant flowers. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of conditions such as fever, headache, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Elaeagnus glabra var. oxyphylla include its antimicrobial, antiseptic, and anti-inflammatory effects, which may aid in wound healing and the treatment of infections. The plant's bioactive constituents include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
